title: Bram and the Language
author: Orsen Dravenmoor
blurb: Emrys Eriksen, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
